property_summary: For any admissible supply, supplyTokenTo(amount, to) must credit the recipient's savings-credit balance so that c.imBalances(to) equals the credits issued (equal to amount at the stub's 1:1 rate); the mutant never writes imBalances, so imBalances(to) stays 0 and violates the rule for any nonzero amount.
change_summary: Delete the statement `imBalances[to] += creditsIssued;` so the caller's imBalances is never credited after supplying.
